StakeWise and Lido routes through PulseChain lending and
governance
2 October 2026. Read-only research at PulseChain block 27,690,565, hash 
0x8eafcc2cbd9f3c7fd00a499ba4173ba098bc207762d553543f998be5bac03334, timestamp 01:24:15 UTC. Historical
comparisons use the inherited block 17,232,999. No transactions or setter simulations were submitted.
sETH2 already has direct exchange and lending integrations. Silo also has a voting path to
important permissions without taking over its owner Safe. These findings strengthen the
proposed network, but do not establish a completed Silo takeover or a working L2 bridge. The current
sETH2 implementation fails ERC20 getters, interrupting its routes. Lending additionally needs a working
price and actual assets available to borrow.

The StakeWise proxy study (Appendix 63) records the upgrades, minter permissions and direct local
issuance.

pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 276

Balancer's other links are mainly indirect: the checked Vault has five stETH pools, sixty wstETH pools and
seven FEI pools, but no current rETH2 membership among the selected token candidates. The one sETH2
pool is 0x063c624672e390363b25f0c6c68ad9067c34595b. wsETH2's sole component is sETH2 at one unit per basket
unit; its manager is 0x6654c5561662f2e229c61cc4671be92336c496b9. Changing basket components requires that
basket's permissions and does not automatically change another protocol's collateral policy.
The scoped Fuse census covered 202 directory pools and 789 unique markets. It found sETH2 in
two pools, stETH in five and wstETH in nine, with no exact rETH2 underlying. A directory entry named
StakeWise with no markets was not counted as a listing.
The StakeWise integration proposal explicitly describes depositing sETH2 to borrow FEI in Fuse pool 149.
Current getters confirm that market at 0x18f49849d20bc04059fe9d775df9a38cd1f5ec9f, with 75% collateral factor.
Its comptroller is 0x5f0ae8b07d1a82be7f557ef93551232749a88ca1. Borrowing sETH2 itself is paused; that flag
alone does not prohibit depositing sETH2 to borrow a different asset. The separate FEI market, 
0xb1eada44fc85607f837626930afb621c33d0ef2d, has zero cash. A FEI loan would remain debt.
The FEI/3CRV pool 0x06cb22615ba53e60d67bf6c341a0fd5e718e1655 holds about 46,870 FEI and 1,509,469 3CRV
shares internally. Its underlying quote returns approximately 0.999255 pDAI per FEI for a one-FEI
input. This connects FEI to the proposed stablecoin network, subject to actual execution and liquidity. A
3CRV share is not automatically one dollar.
Lido can supply local stETH without governance control
The current Lido implementation exactly matches its inherited pre-V2 Ethereum implementation. It
accepts native PLS deposits and issues local stETH against its native-unit accounting; it does not accept
arbitrary sETH2 or an L2 stablecoin through submit.
The sampled recent 200-block interval contains 199 receipt-verified deposits totalling 4,687.5
PLS. The stake limit refills at 23.4375 PLS per block, up to 150,000 PLS; at the pinned block its
available allowance is zero. Thus local issuance continues, but its deposit rate is bounded. Its inherited
beacon accounting is not evidence of Ethereum withdrawal rights.
One wstETH represents approximately 1.1232654 stETH. That wrapper cannot simply substitute sETH2
for its immutable stETH input. Local Curve quotes can differ greatly from inherited accounting: the main
PLS/stETH pool quotes about 244.51 PLS per stETH for one stETH. This suggests a local arbitrage
branch to investigate; it does not establish unlimited profit or external-dollar value. Deposit allowance,
fees, price impact, inventory and actual transfers govern realized results.
Lido is governable through its inherited LDO/Aragon voting stack. Selected permission managers and
implementation addresses match the fork, and the selected post-fork governance history contains no
changes or new votes. These checks do not prove group control. They also do not make Lido immutable:
sufficient valid voting power could change permissions and implementations.
Aave V3 lists wstETH, with ordinary collateral LTV 68.5% and a 200,000-wstETH supply cap. Exact
sETH2 and stETH are not listed there. Its DAI/USDC/USDT receipt contracts hold zero underlying cash at
the checkpoint, but its copied-WETH receipt holds about 1,649,712.62 native-wrapper units. This is a
funded local-asset candidate; successful borrowing still requires all account, price and reserve checks.
Inherited dollar oracle values do not establish dollar convertibility.
Compound III's WETH market lists wstETH, but has zero base-WETH cash at the checkpoint. Compound
V2's enumerated markets do not list these exact three assets. Current Aave V2 and legacy Euler getter
failures leave their current operation unresolved; failed calls were not treated as proof of no listing. The
selected Reserve eUSD registry accepts none of these three exact assets. This does not assess every
Reserve basket.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 277

The 1inch StakeWise campaign concerned SWISE/1INCH liquidity. It is not evidence that 1inch provides
an sETH2 collateral market or that its Ethereum aggregation service executes these PulseChain routes.
Silo control can pass through voting rather than the owner Safe
The actual inherited repository is 0xd998c35b7900b344bbbe6555cc11576942cf309d. T wo later Ethereum
deployment addresses sampled have no PulseChain code; their absence does not disprove other
deployments. Verified runtime matches identify the following legacy authority path:
The governor is 0xa89163f7b2d68a8fba6ca36beed32bd4f3eeaf61; its timelock is 
0xe1f03b7b0ebf84e9b9f62a1db40f1efb8faa7d22. The timelock manages both the repository and price-provider
repository. It owns SILO (0x6f80310ca7f2c654691d1383149fa1a57d8ab1f8) and XAI
(0xd7c9f0e536dc865ae858b0c0453fe76d13c3beac). SILO's verified source contains an owner-only mint function.
Consequently, an initially successful governor proposal could mint more voting tokens and strengthen
subsequent voting control. That is a concrete potential control path, not evidence that it occurred.
Current parameters are a 100,000-SILO proposal threshold, one-block voting delay, 21,000-block voting
period and 1% quorum: 10 million votes at the present billion-token supply. The timelock adds 
two days. At ten seconds per block, voting plus timelock takes roughly 4.43 days, before execution;
block-based voting time varies. Minting more SILO also increases later quorum because quorum uses
historical total supply. Votes must be delegated at the relevant snapshot; balances alone are insufficient.
The full timelock role/scheduling history from block zero identifies only the governor as remaining
proposer and executor, with the timelock itself as remaining admin. No selected timelock schedule or
role event occurs after the fork. The repository owner Safe remains 3-of-5 and has no enabled modules
in its current paginated listing. Those findings do not identify the holders of its private keys.
The observed July 2024 proposal tried to transfer six ownership/manager positions to 
0x48fc8b22ae5319786a8e25ef49b1b49942000000. Its current state is Defeated: approximately 9.703 million
affirmative votes, below the ten-million quorum, with no opposition. No post-fork governor execution
or selected timelock execution was returned in the completed history. The proposal's owner-only
repository calls also require the separate owner's authorization; control of manager permissions alone
would not authorize them.

The proposer later transferred its SILO away and currently has zero votes. The sampled research wallets
hold about 6.274 million SILO at 1967, undelegated, and 2.377 million at e121, self-delegated.
Their combined balances are below quorum; they are not a complete census of a possible coordinated
group. Neither those balances nor the defeated proposal establishes a completed takeover. A successful
execution, changed authority, sufficient attributable snapshot voting power, or another governed
deployment could establish additional control.
The registered sETH2 Silo is 0x76f7e7b28aee365ad89a780a911a373ad168e4fc, with 50% collateral LTV. It is paused,
its selected price provider is zero, and its copied-WETH liquidity is zero. Governance control could
remove manager-side obstacles, but a new price provider's registration and LTV changes are owner-side
powers. The wstETH Silo 0x4f5717f1efdec78a960f08871903b394e7ea95ed is unpaused and has WETH/XAI liquidity,
but its current price getter fails. Listing is not sufficient for a usable loan.
What the four supplied transactions establish
Transaction Verified action Consequence

optimistic proposal through module

Reverses that module ownership
change in this transaction
cb53…42ee ca509…dee0 sets epoch-eight Merkle
root on distributor 
0x1a2e39b54f153dc3582615fbb8544a3cb

Updates native-PLS reward

The ShapeShift treasury address is 0x90a48d5cf7343b08da12e067680b4c6dbfe551be, identified in ShapeShift's own
governance forum. On PulseChain it currently has the optimistic module enabled. A subsequent
ownership event at block 27,378,842 transfers the module to e121 again, consistent with its current
owner getter. Subsequent successful liveness changes include a ten-second window; the current setting
is 1,000,001 seconds, about 11.57 days. Thus the group demonstrably exercised configuration
authority over this module. Its owner can change the rules and dispute window, while Safe calls still
follow the proposal/assertion execution path. These transactions do not demonstrate that the same
module controls Silo.
UMA's emergency-proposer owner still reads GovernorV2, 0x7b292034084a41b9d441b71b6e3557edd0463fa8. The
exact Admin 195 request's hasPrice is false; getPrice reverts with “Current voting round not ended.” The
vote commitment does not reveal the vote choice or prove the requested transfer completed.
The rewards distributor's current owner and whitelisted root setter are 
0xca50938949a3ccf3960537a01bda9973d6c8dee0. It lists 43 pool addresses and holds about 245.16 million
native PLS. A Merkle root commits to a claims list; it is not proof of an external-chain asset balance.
Adding a pool to this distributor's list does not give it that pool's administrative rights or prove fees were
collected from it. Beneficiary amounts and the origin of the funds were not reconstructed here.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 279

Evidence and reproduction
Additional basket and vault evidence is recorded in the StakeWise vault and Index Coop study (Appendix
64). dsETH directly contains sETH2 and has an installed rETH2-to-sETH2 reinvestment extension. Opium
supplies an options-collateral connection, while a deployed Babylon strategy joins native staking with
those two tokens' exchange routes. The original StakeWise reward oracle and distributor share the
controlled StakeWise administrator. dsETH's separate Safe and Orca membership authority match
inherited snapshots; group control of that basket remains unproved.
Evidence is saved under artifacts/pulsechain-lido-lending-20261002/; explicit batches are under Research/
experiments/. Getter snapshots preserve block/hash metadata, requests and responses. Event batches
preserve the full queried ranges and verify selected logs against successful receipts and block headers.
The original Silo price-repository history had eight transport gaps; silo-governance-retry.json closes those
exact ranges with no errors. Negative conclusions are limited to the selected contracts, signatures,
ranges and RPC completeness.
Use Research/scripts/probe_pulsechain_routes.py --block 0x1a68645 --calls <manifest> --output <new-file> for the
explicit getter batches and Research/scripts/collect_pulsechain_events.py --manifest <manifest> --output <new-
file> for histories. Existing evidence files are frozen; reproductions require new output names. Both
commands retain the chain and pinned endpoint hash. The Balancer census filters exact ABI token words
before receipt verification and then checks current Vault membership; excluded logs are retained in raw
responses. The unfiltered preliminary Balancer attempt was interrupted and is not a completed evidence
run.
The research suite passed 76 tests and 82 subtests after collector changes. python Research/scripts/
verify_pulsechain_stakewise_lending.py --evidence artifacts/pulsechain-lido-lending-20261002 passed 92 offline
evidence checks, including the four transaction/header/receipt/trace relationships, linked authority
facts, listing counts, and completed governance histories. Its output and hashes of 348 evidence files are
retained in verification.json and sha256.json. These checks establish internal consistency; they do not
remove trust in the RPC or explorer's verification.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 280
